# Party states

`rq.ids.party_state`: where a character is (`登録状態`), as `rq.party.state` and `rq.chara.get(iic).state` give it and `rq.party.roster` takes it. The game names none; these names are ours, after its functions `キャラ_スタメン` to `キャラ_２軍`. 5 entries.

| Number | Key | Name |
| ---: | --- | --- |
| 0 | `NONE` | None |
| 1 | `PARTY` | Party |
| 2 | `RESERVE` | Reserve |
| 3 | `USED` | Used |
| 4 | `SECOND` | Second |
